subject: Include Stripe Checkout in Shiny App

messages.author: 1caf5dba8a07ba7a
messages.subject: Include Stripe Checkout in Shiny App
parts:
Hello Shiny Team!

I am trying to include the basic stripe checkout html inside a shiny app;


output$StripeCheckout <- renderUI({
    div(HTML('       
<form action="/charge" method="POST">
  <script
    src="https://checkout.stripe.com/checkout.js" class="stripe-button"
    data-key="pk_test_qdunoptxl9KNXR5qk7WdtkVg"
    data-image="/square-image.png"
    data-name="Demo Site"
    data-description="2 widgets ($20.00)"
    data-amount="2000">
  </script>
</form>
     '})

I can see the single original call to the stripe API in the javascript console:
GET https://checkout.stripe.com/v3/checkout/button.css
 
but shiny never renders the button!


Any ideas?

Thanks!

- Jason
